import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def frames(g):
    # find bounding rectangles whose border is one nonzero color, interior background
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); import collections
    seen=collections.defaultdict(bool); res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==0 or seen.get((i,j)): continue
            # expand rectangle while border matches c
            r=i
            while r<h and g[r][j]==c: r+=1
            r2=r-1
            cl=j
            while cl<w and g[i][cl]==c: cl+=1
            cl2=cl-1
            ok=True
            for r in range(i,r2+1):
                if any(g[r][k] not in (c,0) for k in range(cl,cl2+1)): ok=False;break
            for k in range(j,cl2+1):
                if any(g[r][k] not in (c,0) for r in range(i,r2+1)): ok=False;break
            if not ok: continue
            inner=[(r,k) for r in range(i+1,r2) for k in range(j+1,cl2)]
            if len(inner)>=1: res.append((len(inner),i,i+1,r2-i-1,j,j+1,cl2-j-1,c,inner))
    res.sort(key=lambda t:t[0])
    return res
# check demo

fs=frames(di); print([ (f[0],f[8]) for f in fs][:5])
for f in fs:
    for r,c_ in f[8]: di[r][c_]=0
for idx,(sz,i,j,r2,c2,l2,col,inner) in enumerate(fs):
